definitions.explanation: A product that has been fully manufactured and is ready for use or sale. Contrasted with raw materials, parts, or works in progress.

examples.japanese: {完成品|かんせいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{模型|もけい}→模型：07079_mokei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{完成品|かんせいひん}な⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{組|く}み{立|た}てる→組み立てる：04661_kumitateru⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This model is a finished product, so there is no need to assemble it.

examples.japanese: ⟦{工場|こうじょう}→工場：01082_koujou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{何千|なんぜん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{完成品|かんせいひん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出荷|しゅっか}→出荷：05135_shukka⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Thousands of finished products are shipped from the factory every day.

notes:
USAGE:
Used in manufacturing, commerce, and hobbyist contexts (models, crafts). In online shopping, {完成品|かんせいひん} indicates a ready-made item as opposed to a kit that requires assembly.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {完成品|かんせいひん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出荷|しゅっか}→出荷：05135_shukka⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to ship finished products)
- {完成品|かんせいひん}⟦{在庫|ざいこ}→在庫：04701_zaiko⟧ (finished goods inventory)
- {完成品|かんせいひん}⟦{検査|けんさ}→検査：02707_kensa⟧ (finished product inspection)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{製品|せいひん}→製品：01445_seihin⟧: product, manufactured goods — broader term for any product
- ⟦{半製品|はんせいひん}→半製品：26437_hanseihin⟧: semi-finished product, work in progress
